gauntlet: done summary

### What is broken

Opening `/widgets/` shows a page not found (404) error instead of the widgets page. The local reproduction confirmed this.

### Why it is broken

The part that matches URLs to pages compares the address exactly as typed, so the extra slash at the end prevents a match (`src/router.ts:88`). Testing ruled out other explanations.

### How to fix it

Strip the trailing slash before comparing paths, so `/widgets` and `/widgets/` both open the page. This is already tracked in an existing ticket, and follow-up belongs there (https://github.com/example/widgets/issues/42). No new ticket was created, and the tracker was not changed.
